verses.text: A Song of the Ascents. Blessed [is] everyone who fears YHWH, those walking in His ways!

segments.text: A Song of the Ascents. Blessed [is] everyone who fears YHWH, those walking in His ways!

verses.text: The labor of your hands, surely you shall eat; blessings and good [are] unto you.

segments.text: The labor of your hands, surely you shall eat; blessings and good [are] unto you.

verses.text: Your wife [is] fruitful like a vine in the sides of your house, your sons like shoots of olive trees round about your table.

segments.text: Your wife [is] fruitful like a vine in the sides of your house, your sons like shoots of olive trees round about your table.

verses.text: Behold, how thus is blessed the man fearing YHWH.

segments.text: Behold, how thus is blessed the man fearing YHWH.

verses.text: May YHWH bless you from Zion, that you may look on the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life,

segments.text: May YHWH bless you from Zion, that you may look on the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life,

verses.text: and may you see the sons of your sons! Peace [be] upon Israel!
